name: 98580 · Roy, WA
findings: ZIP 98580 (Roy) has 14 nonprofit organizations. 5 of them (36%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 4 organizations.
Hobby and sports organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (40% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 98580 (Roy) has fewer organizations offering opportunities per resident.
